description_en: Adds binding relationships between service instances and real numbers in batches
description_zh: 批量添加服务实例与真实号码绑定关系
name: AddVirtualNumberRelation

parameters.help_en: The product name. Default value: dyvms
parameters.name: prod_code

parameters.help_en: The list of company names. Separate multiple company names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 公司名列表。多个公司之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: corp_name_list

parameters.help_en: The list of real numbers. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,). You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal) and view the purchased real numbers on the Real Number Management page
parameters.help_zh: 真实号码列表。多个号码之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。 您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)，在真实号管理页面查看已购买的真实号
parameters.name: number_list

parameters.help_en:
The routing type. Valid values:

0: home location first.
1: random
parameters.help_zh:
路由类型。取值：

0：归属地优先。
1：随机
parameters.name: route_type

parameters.help_en: The service instance ID. You can log on to the Voice Messaging Service console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list) and view the applied service instances on the Service Instance Management page
parameters.help_zh: 服务实例ID。您可以登录语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/virtual/list)，在服务实例管理页面查看已申请的服务实例
parameters.name: phone_num
